sanskrit_verse:
षड्भागस्तरशुल्कं च गते देयस्तथैव च /
संग्रामचौरभेदी च सस्यघातनकृत् तथा //
transliteration: ṣaḍbhāgas taraśulkaṃ ca gate deyas tathaiva ca / saṃgrāmacaurabhedī ca sasyaghātanakṛt tathā //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who causes division among allies in war, or destroys crops essential for sustenance, shall render a sixth part of their wealth as restitution and bear the cost of passage tolls forfeited thereby.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the capacity to sustain collective integrity
Causation is established through disruption of foundational supports
Capacity-based responsibility applies proportionally to influence exerted
Restoration logic demands proportional return of disrupted resources
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of interdependence
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent disrupts agricultural yield THEN levy one-sixth asset value restitution
IF entity causes factional breach during conflict THEN impose toll-cost liability
IF action undermines community sustenance THEN enforce resource-based compensation
IF violation traced to causal interference THEN activate proportional restoration protocol
IF accountability confirmed THEN initiate consciousness-realignment completion process
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this injunction governs infrastructural betrayals that destabilize national cohesion or agrarian stability. The threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable causality between the act and systemic damage. Authority flows from preservation of dharma-rooted order, not punitive dominance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes direct causality between divisive acts and resultant harm. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals sequential breakdowns initiated by betrayal. Proportional responsibility aligns with economic benefit derived or harm caused. Non-punitive reality rule prevails as consequence naturally arises from misaligned conduct.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Wealth fraction restitution aligned with impacted scale
Community reintegration facilitated via service completion
Economic transparency audit mandated for involved parties
Collective integrity ceremony enacted upon resolution
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Dharma is restored when causality meets conscious correction; justice flows from alignment, not punishment; reality responds to truth, not force.
